description: Modal dialog for exporting a wireframe. Lets the user choose a file name, output format (PNG or PDF), image scale (1x-3x, PNG only), and whether to include the background, then raises OnExport with the assembled export options. The footer pairs a Secondary (outline) Cancel with the Primary Export button.

parameters.name: Show
parameters.description: Whether the dialog is visible. Every closed-to-open transition resets the form (file name, format, scale, background).

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the user cancels, presses Escape or clicks the overlay. The host should set Show to false.

parameters.name: OnExport
parameters.description: Raised with the chosen file name, format and options when the user confirms the export.

parameters.name: DefaultFileName
parameters.description: File name proposed (and restored) every time the dialog opens.

parameters.name: InitialFormat
parameters.description: Format preselected every time the dialog opens: "png" (default) or "pdf" (case-insensitive). Any other value falls back to PNG.

parameters.name: MobilePresentation
parameters.description: How the dialog presents on a narrow viewport. Auto follows the core viewport scope: a bottom sheet on a phone, the centred dialog otherwise; a forced value pins one presentation. The footer is always inline (Cancel and Export side by side, sticky in the sheet).
